rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the nearby area around a place or thing.

example.english: Is there a subway station in the surrounding area of this restaurant?
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳附近有冇地鐵站？
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 fu6 gan6 jau5 mou5 dei6 tit3 zaam6

rows.note: Use this when stressing the area all around a particular place or person, rather than simply somewhere nearby.

example.english: Look, there are people all around in the surrounding area.
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 haa5 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6 jan4

rows.note: Use this for the environment or general conditions in which someone or something exists.

example.english: The surrounding environment here is pretty quiet and suitable for studying.
example.traditional: 呢度嘅環境幾清靜，適合讀書。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 ge3 waan4 ging2 gei2 cing1 zing6 sik1 hap6 duk6 syu1
